lastCompletedStory.title: Update the /cam-issue filing contract to author oracle forms into the payload

nextStoryContext: The /cam-issue create contract (.claude/commands/cam-issue.md `local` -> `create` subsection, mirrored byte-identically to templates/commands/cam-issue.md and re-embedded into src/vendor/_generated.ts) now documents the derived/fast-track filing payload: step 4 requires a `spec` object ({ acceptanceCriteria, scope, gotchas, domainTerms }) whenever --derived-from/--fast-track is used, instructs the filer to write the LITERAL oracle text per acceptance criterion and sweep it RED against main before filing (not merely include a criteria key), shows a single-quoted heredoc example (CAM-106 safe-quoting), and documents the CAM_ISSUE_RESULT=ERROR reason=guardrail-failed refusal contract (matches src/commands/issue-file.ts's real `guardrail-failed` reason string, verified by grep). This closes the gap US-002 opened: the filing-time spec channel now has its sole documented producer (.claude/commands/cam-issue.md) actually instructing the filer to populate it. No production TS code changed in this story -- doc-only plus the mechanical embed-vendor regen. validate-agents-md's scan surface (CLAUDE.md, scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md, .claude/agents/*.md) does NOT include .claude/commands/*.md, so the 'doc-as-code path check' AC9 language in the story referred to the check:all spine passing overall, not a scan of cam-issue.md specifically -- confirmed by reading scripts/validate-agents-md.ts's SCAN_FILES/AGENTS_GLOB constants.
